(C.I.D.) Office Notes
April 23, 1930.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 1193.
Date...25...4...30.

Shanghai Chinese Press Workers' Union

The meeting convened by the above Union for this afternoon
to discuss the dismissal from the "China Times" and elimination
from union membership of six printers did not take place owing
to lack of attendance. From attached translation of a
handbill issued by the Union, it will be seen that Tu Niang-tsz,
for the past eighteen months all powerful in the type-setting
room of the "China Times" and a thorn in the side of the
management, has at last incurred the enmity of the Union.
This man has always been prominent in agitation among the
"China Times" printers, but so far has been sufficiently
cunning not to commit himself in the eyes of the law. The
action of the Union in ousting Tu and his five followers is
a step in the right direction, although we shall require to
keep in close contact with the "China Times" in regard to his
movements and possible threats by him and his following.
It will also be advisable to give the Editorial Office
(Shantung Road) and the Type-setting Room (40.A. Kiangse Road)
special police attention for the next few days.
I have not been able to get in touch with Mr. Pan, Editor
of the China Times" today but will endeavour to interview him
tomorrow with a view to impressing on him the necessity for
holding out against any demands that Tu be reinstated.

（左侧手写批注：not by the dismissed workers.）

Jno Robertson
C. D. I.

（左下角手写批注：
Information
S.C. (S.B.)
24/4
Ruth
Informed.

S.B. (B. and Sp. Branches),
Information, Central Station

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
1930年4月23日。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 D. 登记处
编号 I. O. D. 1193。
日期……25……4……30。

上海中文报业工会

上述工会原定于今天下午召开会议，讨论开除六名《字林西报》（China Times）印刷工人并取消其工会会员资格一事，但因出席人数不足而未果。从随附的该工会所发传单的译文可以看出，屠仰之（Tu Niang-tsz）在过去十八个月里一直是《字林西报》排版室的权势人物，也是管理方的眼中钉，如今终于招致了工会的敌视。此人一直在《字林西报》印刷工人中积极从事煽动活动，但迄今为止一直足够狡猾，未在法律层面留下把柄。工会驱逐屠氏及其五名追随者的举动是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，尽管我们需要与《字林西报》保持密切联系，以关注其动向以及他和其追随者可能发出的威胁。
此外，建议在未来几天内对编辑部（山东路）和排版室（江西路40A号）给予特别的警力关注。
我今天未能联系上《字林西报》编辑潘先生，但将尽力于明天会见他，以便向他强调必须顶住任何要求复职屠氏的压力。

（左侧手写批注：并非由被解雇工人发起。）

Jno Robertson
刑事侦缉处处长

（左下角手写批注：
情报
特别分部 (S.B.)
4月24日
Ruth
已获悉。
）

特别分部（行动及特种分支），
情报，中央巡捕房
副本已送交 A 区警司，机动队
1930年4月23日。

Translation of a handbill emanating from the Executive
Committee of Shanghai Chinese Press Workers' Union, dated
April 21:

A letter to all Press Workers giving reasons why the
following six members have been struck off the membership list
of the Union and ordered to cease work:-
Li Ho Sung (李荷生)             Tu Niang-tsz (屠仰之)
Chang Foh Shing (張福興)        Chu Kyih-an (朱吉安)
Tu Ching-keng (杜清根)          Chu Kwei-sung (朱桂生)

We regret having been compelled to strike off from our
membership list the above six persons and to order them to
stop working. Our object is to lead the workers and protect
their interest, yet despite this fact we had to withdraw our
protection from them and to expel them from our ranks. Of
course we are not to blame for their action, still we are much
concerned at a lack of trust and confidence of the Union which
prevails among our fellow members. The aims of our union have
already been explained in our previous letter and need no
repetition here. The six above-mentioned workers, however,
have ignored our aims and have frequently strayed to forbidden
paths to attain their selfish aims. For this reason we cannot
remain indifferent and accordingly have decided to eliminate
them before they have succeeded in corrupting our union.
"A Strong man will amputate his limb when it is bitten by a
poisonous snake." What a sad thing it is.

Furthermore in the interests of you, our members, we
hope that you will give us the support we need. You will
correct our mistakes and help us in every way. To save ourselves
from annihilation we have to punish those who are bent on mischief.

Chopped: The Executive Committee of the Shanghai Press
Workers' Union.

上海中文报业工会执行委员会于4月21日发出的传单译文：

致全体报业工人的一封信，说明为何将以下六名成员从工会会员名单中除名并责令停止工作：-
李荷生 (Li Ho Sung)             屠仰之 (Tu Niang-tsz)
張福興 (Chang Foh Shing)        朱吉安 (Chu Kyih-an)
杜清根 (Tu Ching-keng)          朱桂生 (Chu Kwei-sung)

我们遗憾地被迫将上述六人从会员名单中除名，并责令他们停止工作。我们的宗旨是领导工人并保护他们的利益，然而尽管如此，我们不得不撤回对他们的保护，并将他们开除出我们的队伍。当然，他们的行为责任不在我们，但我们非常担忧在会员之间普遍存在的对工会缺乏信任的现象。我们工会的宗旨已在之前的信函中阐明，此处无需赘述。然而，上述六名工人无视我们的宗旨，经常走上歧途以实现其自私的目的。鉴于此，我们不能坐视不管，因此决定在他们成功腐蚀我们的工会之前将其清除。“壮士断腕”，实乃悲事。

此外，为了你们——我们的会员的利益，我们希望你们给予我们所需的支持。请纠正我们的错误，并在各方面帮助我们。为了免于覆灭，我们必须惩罚那些一心作乱之人。

盖章：上海报业工会执行委员会。

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
April 23, 1930.
The workers in the China Times have a union which is
registered with the Social Bureau in Chinese controlled
territory. Acting on the recommendation of this Union,
the management of the newspaper dismissed 5 or 6 workers on
April 22. The dismissed workers are all alleged to be
important agitators and to have among their supporters the
radical elements of various Chinese newspapers. They are
now planning to cause inconvenience to the owners of the
paper, and in furtherance of this object will hold a meeting in
the China Times printing office, No. 40a Kiangse Road, between
2 and 5 p.m. April 23.
The above information has been obtained from Mr. Waung
Ying Ping of the Shun Pao who is a shareholder of the China
Times.
J. Givers
A. C.
Deputy Commissioner
(Cr. & Sp. Branches).

档案号
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
1930年4月23日。
《字林西报》的工人拥有一个在华界社会局注册的工会。根据该工会的建议，报社管理层于4月22日解雇了5或6名工人。据称，被解雇的工人均为重要的煽动分子，且在各类中文报纸的激进分子中拥有支持者。他们目前正策划给报社业主制造麻烦，为推进这一目的，将于4月23日下午2时至5时在江西路40A号的《字林西报》印刷厂举行会议。
上述情报来自《申报》股东、同时也是《字林西报》股东的汪英平（Waung Ying Ping）先生。
J. Givers
助理总监
（刑事及特种分支）。
（批：何种煽动分子？）
（批：(X)）
（批：gR）
